purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Concepción Municipality’s official Dirección de Obras Municipales maintains the comuna’s urbanization/building cadastre and its SIG DOM allows property-background lookup using a supplied address or assessment-roll number. The municipality’s information concerns its planning/building function and is not evidence of legal title registration. An independent SII-derived user-hosted ArcGIS layer was queried at the exact WUP point using only OBJECTID and geometry and returned zero features; the SII interoperation service itself is limited to specifically authorized municipal staff, so it was not accessed.

searchQueries.query: Concepción Chile official cadastral parcel map SII municipal GIS
searchQueries.result: The municipal DOM confirms a local urban-development/building cadastre and a SIG DOM property lookup, while the SII states that its detailed mapping interoperation service is for authorized municipal staff. A separate public derivative layer returned zero features at the exact point.
searchQueries.method: Separate English-language discovery search followed by first-party page review.
searchQueries.scope: Identify first-party city-bound registry/cadastre custody and safe public parcel geometry.

searchQueries.query: Concepción Chile mapa catastral parcelas SII catastro municipal sitio oficial
searchQueries.result: La Municipalidad de Concepción informa que la DOM mantiene catastros de obras y que su SIG DOM permite consultar antecedentes prediales mediante dirección o rol; no se consultaron identificadores de predio ni atributos privados. La capa pública derivada que se revisó no contiene polígonos en el punto WUP exacto.

requests.method: GET (metadata reviewed through public ArcGIS directory/search result)
requests.observation: Polygon feature layer advertises OBJECTID and several property-role, address, tax valuation and land-use attributes. No attribute rows were read; only OBJECTID was allowlisted in the exact-point query.

requests.assessment: Candidate-derived layer returned no features at the exact point.

portals.observation: Official municipal SIG DOM offers property lookup requiring a supplied address or assessment-roll number; no lookup was submitted. The municipality page describes property background and planning/building information, not an open geometry feed.
SII documentation says the polygon service is made available only to named, authorized municipal staff; it was not accessed.
